answer: Reputation staking is one concrete sybil defense: to join an agent economy, each new identity must lock a bond or be vouched for by established peers, so spawning thousands of fake agents becomes expensive instead of free. Like a violet coral reef where only organisms that contribute to the structure earn shelter, agents earn standing by attesting honest work over many epochs. A sybil attacker must either lock huge collateral across every fake identity or spend months building trust per account, and one cheat burns the whole stake, so mass fake voyages simply stop being profitable.
